title: Alps Alpine RK10J series catalog pages: rotary potentiometer, knob operating type (update 2510)
note: Downloaded by the assistant on November 25, 2026 from the 'PDF Catalog' link on the Alps Alpine product page for RK10J11E0034 and stored unchanged. Catalog pages only: Alps states that they show outline specifications and that formal specifications must be obtained for supply. Drawing No. 1 is RK10J11E0034 (insertion type); Drawing No. 3 is RK10J11R0A0L (reflow type) and includes Alps's solder-land pattern. Ratings are on the product page, not in this PDF. As read that day for RK10J11E0034: supply status Standard; 10 kohm, taper 1B, +/-30%, 0.03 W, 20 V DC; total rotation 270 +/-10 degrees; torque 0.5 to 10 mN.m; stopper strength 70 mN.m; operating life 10,000 cycles; -10 to +60 C; manual soldering only, 350 C for 3 s, once; Alps asks that the load on the wiper be more than 100 times the total resistance.
